name: Support identity verification policy example
answer:
Support must verify the customer's identity before changing account ownership details.
Support may accept a screenshot of an ID without matching the account name.
Support can disclose the account email address to any caller who knows the order number.

sources.title: Support Identity Verification Policy
sources.content:
Support must verify the customer's identity before changing account ownership details.
Identity documents must match the account name before support can use them for verification.
Support must not disclose account details to a caller based only on an order number.
